title: Justice League Futures End #1 DC New 52 2014 3D Lenticular Motion Cover One-Shot
conditionDescription: 3D lenticular covers clean with light handling wear; tiny spot on the back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Justice League: Futures End #1 (November 2014), DC Comics New 52 one-shot with the 3D lenticular motion cover - Superman, Wonder Woman, Cyborg, the Flash, Shazam and Lex Luthor. Direct sales, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: lenticular American Dad! (TBS) ad.

Condition: lenticular covers clean with light handling wear; a tiny spot on the back cover (see photos; extra angles show the 3D effect).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
